items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee mentions Illinois Jacquet in a list of notable musicians ('Illinois Jacquet and Flip Phillips') and acknowledges the name when prompted, but does not describe a personal interaction, collaboration, or mentorship.

ctx.x: ...and they’re telling you to come to New York—and you spend some time in New York. So finally, in 1950, was it...
